sources.snippet: A NAR (texture/timbre) LoRA for YuE2 that supplies 1980s Eurodisco production character: dense wall-of-sound production, chorused synth bass, four-on-the-floor drums with gated toms, stacked synth pads, brass/strings stabs, 80s studio gloss. Released CC0 by James E. Petts. The two files are the same ...
